response.answer: Work-family equilibrium significantly influences employee proactive behaviors, with positive facilitation enhancing such behaviors. Studies show that work-family conflict negatively impacts proactive behavior, often mediated by emotional exhaustion. Family supportive supervisor behavior also positively affects employee proactive behavior.
